purpose: Phase-6A PROTEIN-FUNCTION CONTEXT registry. Function profiles binding a Phase-5D mature protein to a functional cellular effect. Consumed READ-ONLY. A protein affects cellular state only when mature (from Phase 5D), not degraded, in the active species/cell, with a compatible profile and evidence not UNAVAILABLE. Human HaCaT is the most developed profile; mouse melanoma early responses are SIGNAL-driven (no protein output from 5D) and live in the cellular-state + functional-edges registries; rat is NOT_REPORTED. STOPS before cell fate (cell_fate_evidence = NOT_EVALUATED).

fn_ho1.uncertainty: Celastrol-induced HO-1 anti-inflammatory / antioxidant regulatory effect is described in the literature but NOT verified in this repo; would be EXPERIMENTAL_DRUG_CELL_SPECIFIC only with a verified in-repo primary source. Magnitude/timing NOT_REPORTED.

fn_nqo1.uncertainty: NQO1 antioxidant-support capacity is a canonical prediction; no same-context primary evidence. No catalytic chemistry / substrate turnover.

fn_infl_adhesion.uncertainty: Schematic ICAM1-like adhesion readiness tracks the suppressed inflammatory protein abundance. Not named ICAM1 (no verified evidence). No monocytes/leukocytes/recruitment/vascular adhesion.

mouse_b16bl6.reason: Phase-5D produced no mouse protein output (mouse transcription/translation NOT_REPORTED). The mouse melanoma early-response is SIGNAL-driven (PI3K/AKT/mTOR suppression -> survival-signaling down; exposure -> oxidative stress). It uses no functional proteins; its states + edges live in cellular-state.registry.json + functional-edges.registry.json. Independent from human HaCaT; no transfer. Stops at reversible / preparatory states (NO apoptosis/cell death).

rat_skin.reason: No Phase-5D protein output and no validated intracellular functional response for rat. Protein function is NOT REPORTED (idle). No human/mouse fallback.

context_rules.one_species_one_cell_model: A function profile binds exactly one species + cell model; never mixed.
context_rules.no_silent_transfer: No human keratinocyte function is transferred to mouse melanoma; no melanoma relationship is transferred to keratinocytes; nothing is copied to rat.
context_rules.maturity_gating: Function activates only for a mature, non-degraded protein of the active species/cell with a compatible profile and evidence not UNAVAILABLE.
